title: ARE Scanner design-partner build manifest
description: Per-(partner, OS, build) manifest emitted by infra/dist/build.py. One file per shipped binary. Carries the reproducibility envelope: same git_sha + same source_date_epoch + same pyinstaller_version + same python_version + same target_os + same partner_id (-> same watermark) MUST reproduce binary_sha256 byte-for-byte.

corpus_snapshot_hash.description: Canonical, watermark-free corpus hash. MUST equal the hash stamped into Path 1 / Path 2 / Path 3 score outputs for the same corpus_version (ADR-0011 §3.5 / Supreme Law).

license_endpoint_insecure_allowed.description: true only for stub-loop / debug builds. Partner-bound builds MUST be false.

builder_host.description: Optional context about the build host. Useful for reproducibility audits.
